text:
Getting ID for baby
Hi everyone, me and my partner have submitted our first application to misrad hapinim beer sheva. Yet to hear back from them. Meanwhile I'm about to give birth anytime. I'm currently on A2 visa and my husband is Israeli. 

Can someone help me understand what we can expect at hospital, will baby get ID? 

Do we contact misrad hapinim separately for this or wait to hear back from them on our application? 

Do we go to lawyer and get paternity test ready?

Also, anybody knows timings to go to MH beer sheva without appointment? Do they allow walk ins all days, shud we go around 7:15 am?
